row.evidence: Supabase provides SAML SSO for Team and Enterprise customers with optional domain auto-join on sign-in, but its docs say to revoke access by disabling the user in the IdP and removing their Supabase permissions; no SCIM endpoint is documented.
row.notes: None by absence. Flat per-organization pricing with unlimited team members (Pro from $25/mo, Team from $599/mo). Dashboard SSO (SAML) from Team per the plan card and docs; the comparison table shows SSO as 'Contact Us' for Team. Users join via invitation or SSO auto-join (JIT); removal is manual. Management API (PAT/OAuth2) can list members, change roles and manage invitations but has no member-removal endpoint. Platform audit logs on Team and Enterprise. Okta OIN app is SAML only.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_text: From $25 / month (first project included; additional projects from $10/mo)
plans.notes: Flat per organization; unlimited team members.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Plan card lists 'SSO for Supabase Dashboard'; the comparison table says SSO 'Contact Us' for Team (see conflicts).

scim.notes: No SCIM endpoint or IdP provisioning guide was found in the pricing page, docs (llms-full.txt), Management API reference or SSO guides. Dashboard SSO setup guides use custom SAML apps in Okta, Entra and Google Workspace.

capabilities.notes: Members are added only by invitation; no endpoint to remove an organization member appears in the Management API reference.

endpoints.purpose: List members with roles and project-scoped permissions (paginated)
Assign or change an organization member role

okta.notes: OIN 'Supabase' listing ticks SAML (and Cross App Access); no provisioning. Supabase's own guide uses a custom SAML 2.0 app integration.

entra.notes: Supabase's guide uses 'Create your own application' (non-gallery); no Learn tutorial found.

google.notes: Supabase's guide uses a custom SAML app.

fallbacks.notes: SSO auto-join adds users with a matching domain on sign-in with a default role; removal is manual in Supabase.

conflicts.text: The Team plan card lists 'SSO for Supabase Dashboard', and the SSO docs say SAML SSO is for Team and Enterprise customers, but the plan comparison table shows SSO as 'Contact Us' for Team and Enterprise.

open_questions: Whether Team includes dashboard SSO self-serve or only via sales (pricing card vs comparison table).
No documented API to remove an organization member.
Management API rate limits are not stated in the reference (fair-use policy only).
